Abut Smoky Mountain Cup Tennessee

The Smoky Mountain Cup began in 2020 with indoor tournaments featuring teams from Atlanta, Georgia; North Carolina; South Carolina; and teams from the state of Tennessee!"

The cup is played in the state of Tennessee, at a complex that boasts an extraordinary view of the mountains!

The first champion:
Coringa (Tennessee) vs Guerrero (Atlanta).

  • Then another indoor tournament was held again. The champion was the Atlanta Premier League, with Coringas finishing as the runner-up.
  • In the same year, another tournament was held. The champion was Rios-chupano (Atlanta), with Coringas finishing as the runner-up.
  • There were 3 indoor tournaments held in the year 2020, collectively called the SMOKY MOUNTAIN CUP.
  • We also started organizing women's tournaments.

About

The Smoky Mountain Cup, inaugurated in 2020, emerged as a thrilling showcase of indoor soccer prowess, drawing teams from Atlanta, Georgia; North Carolina; South Carolina; and Tennessee. Hosted amidst the breathtaking backdrop of Tennessee's majestic mountains, this prestigious tournament captivated fans with its fierce competition and stunning views.

n its debut year, the cup witnessed exhilarating clashes, culminating in a showdown between Coringa from Tennessee and Guerrero from Atlanta, where Coringa emerged as the inaugural champion. Building on this success, subsequent tournaments saw the Atlanta Premier League clinch victory, with Coringa valiantly securing runner-up positions. The inaugural year of the Smoky Mountain Cup marked the inception of a tradition, with three indoor tournaments held under its banner, each showcasing the finest talents in indoor soccer and cementing its status as a premier event on the sporting calendar.
